Recommended: 1920×1080, H.264, loop-friendly, 10-30s
Free sources:
  - NASA Public Domain: https://images.nasa.gov
  - SpaceX YouTube (not free for commercial use)

The HomePage will show a dark fallback gradient if the file is missing.
